top.name: Washing-machine microplastic filter
top.signals: Euronews (2026-07-06): EU moving to make washing-machine microplastic filters mandatory · EU's revised Drinking Water Directive sets first-ever binding microplastic limits; France (EUR2.7B) and Netherlands (EUR850M) funding filtration infra — market CAGR 8.1% 2025-2033
top.risk: Branded incumbents (CLEANR, PlanetCare, Xeros) already own the category story; a generic unit needs real filtration proof or gets dismissed as a knockoff.
top.angle: Sell as 'get ahead of the EU mandate' — cheap external filter unit + subscription replacement cartridges/pods for recurring revenue.

rows.name: Toe spacers
rows.angle: Frame as comfort/recovery for dancers and runners ('yoga for your feet'), not medical correction.

rows.name: Halloween projection lights
rows.angle: Push plug-and-play projector displays now for DE/UK Halloween-party buyers; content angle is instant yard/window transformation.

rows.name: Waterproof dog raincoat + boot sets
rows.angle: Bundle coat+boots as one 'wet-walk kit'; target dog-owner groups with autumn-rain content as clocks change.

rows.name: Autumn-themed pillow covers
rows.angle: Sell small-batch monthly print 'drops' so buyers return for the next design instead of a one-off purchase.

rows.name: Laundry scent beads
rows.angle: Reframe for EU laundry habits — 'wardrobe freshener' for line-dried clothes in small apartments, not a US dryer-sheet pitch.

rows.name: Halloween pet costumes (generic, non-licensed)
rows.angle: Stick to generic animal/food/pun costumes (no licensed characters) optimized for shareable 'dog in costume' clips; cross-sell with the raincoat kit.

rows.name: Bluetooth item finder tags (keys/bags/luggage)
rows.angle: Target EU travelers ahead of autumn trip season; lead with 'never lose your bag again' airport-loss stories.

rows.name: Felt bedside storage organizers
rows.angle: Bundle as a 'cozy nightstand kit' with the autumn pillow covers to lift average order value.

rows.name: LED smart curtain lights
rows.angle: Differentiate hard on format (window-curtain drape) vs the already-saturated LED strip lights from last week's board.
